description:
This house is located in the heart of Nashville and is suitable for large families, bachelorette parties, friends, and business travelers.

Just a short drive from downtown Nashville, our home offers easy access to the city’s vibrant nightlife, top-notch dining, and iconic music scene. Whether you’re here to explore or simply unwind, our home provides the perfect blend of comfort and convenience for an unforgettable stay.

The space
This three-story, 3,100 square foot home is the perfect place for a group of friends to immerse themselves in the vibrant music scene of Nashville. With four spacious bedrooms plus a bonus room, three full bathrooms, and a total of ten beds (four king-size and four queen-size, plus two twin beds), we guarantee that your group will have ample room to relax and spread out. The home also features a large, well-equipped kitchen, a cozy living room, and a charming rooftop patio. We are confident that your group will fall in love with this home and make it a memorable highlight of your Nashville vacation.

Guest access
You’ll have access to the entire home. Before your stay, we’ll send you the access code along with the entry instructions. The host is always available to answer any questions or inquiries you may have. Thanks!
